from __future__ import annotations

from os import environ

from hcloud import Client
from hcloud.networks import NetworkRoute, NetworkSubnet

token = environ["HCLOUD_TOKEN"]
client = Client(token=token)

network = client.networks.create(
    expose_routes_to_vswitch=False,
    ip_range="10.0.0.0/16",
    labels={
        "environment": "prod",
        "example.com/my": "label",
        "just-a-key": "",
    },
    name="mynet",
    routes=[
        NetworkRoute(
            destination="10.100.1.0/24",
            gateway="10.0.1.1",
        )
    ],
    subnets=[
        NetworkSubnet(
            ip_range="10.0.1.0/24",
            network_zone="eu-central",
            type="cloud",
            vswitch_id=1000,
        )
    ],
)

x-codeSamples.label: CLI
x-codeSamples.source:
hcloud network create \
    --expose-routes-to-vswitch=false \
    --ip-range 10.0.0.0/16 \
    --label "environment=prod" \
    --label "example.com/my=label" \
    --label "just-a-key=" \
    --name mynet

hcloud network add-route mynet \
    --destination 10.100.1.0/24 \
    --gateway 10.0.1.1

hcloud network add-subnet mynet \
    --ip-range 10.0.1.0/24 \
    --network-zone eu-central \
    --type cloud \
    --vswitch-id 1000

from __future__ import annotations

from os import environ

from hcloud import Client
from hcloud.firewalls import FirewallResource, FirewallRule
from hcloud.servers import Server

token = environ["HCLOUD_TOKEN"]
client = Client(token=token)

response = client.firewalls.create(
    resources=[
        FirewallResource(
            type="server",
            server=Server(id=42),
        )
    ],
    labels={
        "env": "dev",
    },
    name="Corporate Intranet Protection",
    rules=[
        FirewallRule(
            description="Allow port 80",
            direction="in",
            port="80",
            protocol="tcp",
            source_ips=[
                "192.0.2.2",
                "192.0.2.0/24",
                "2001:0db8:9a3b:ee58:5ca:990c:8bc9:c03b",
            ],
        )
    ],
)

for action in response.actions:
    action.wait_until_finished()

firewall = response.firewall
